steps.text: …whereas the party of the first part is NOCTURNAL… [chuckles] strike that — he'll love it. Keep it in.
Moth. Eleven forty PM. Substantial. Entered. …The registry grows FAT tonight.
…and upon completion: one seat at the table. Perpetuity. Signed… [sighs] …unsigned. Pending.
[chuckles] …seventeen souls, he says. SEVENTEEN. I have fifteen. The audit is coming, pumpkin. The audit is COMING.
…dear master — per my last four hundred correspondences — I remain available. Punctual.
…And I shake, sometimes. So I know you are there.
